protocol.name: sgm_distance_rank_v1
protocol.rank: share of the reference's retained draws strictly farther from the reference's own SGM than the candidate SGM (comparison '>', empirical-CDF lookup with searchsorted side='right'); rows = candidates, columns = references, self reference excluded by group identity (NaN diagonal); generally asymmetric
protocol.metric: estimator coordinates divided by the prior widths (sgm_scale); coordinates are stored as the estimator declares them (log10 for a log row) and are not transformed again
protocol.score: ordinary sample median of the candidate's off-diagonal row (two middle ranks averaged when even); raw, not normalized across candidates; a computed zero is a valid outcome distinct from a missing score

reference_populations.per_cell: the other included cells of the same condition and window set; each reference is its own equal-window cloud mixture
reference_populations.per_cell_window: the other selected windows of the same cell and condition; each reference is one window's own cloud
reference_populations.per_window_position: no rank policy in this scope (uniform selection remains available)
reference_populations.global: no same-level peer (uniform selection remains available)

protocol.availability: computed when at least one other reference group exists in the block; insufficient_peers for a per_cell block with one included cell or a per_cell_window block with one selected window (no score, zero references); not_applicable for per_window_position and global; equivalent groups (an opening per_cell = per_cell_window alias) keep their own availability, scores are never copied

compatibility.bound_to: the target, contract (checkpoint, keys, scale, geometry, draws, pool mode, input conversion), coverage and sources recorded in this manifest

per_cell.name: One representative per cell
per_cell.calculation: pool all retained draws of the cell's selected windows, equal weight per window, and select the SGM
per_cell.interpretation: variation between cell representatives over the declared acquisition period

per_window_position.name: One representative per window position
per_window_position.calculation: at each selected position, pool the retained draws across the included cells, equal weight per cell, and select the SGM
per_window_position.interpretation: variation between acquisition-period representatives, cell differences compressed at each position

global.name: One representative of the selected collection
global.calculation: pool the retained draws with equal cell weight and equal selected-window weight within each cell, and select the SGM
global.interpretation: an overall joint center of the selected collection

per_cell_window.name: One representative per cell-window pair
per_cell_window.calculation: the SGM of each included cell-window posterior
per_cell_window.interpretation: variation between window representatives, cell and window identities retained

coverage_note: Complete cohort: MET-INLB 60 of 60 cells, 600 of 600 windows. The original MAP and summary references above come from the adopted product; the aggregation summaries come from the retained collections named below, fresh draws of the same estimator that do not reconstruct the original sampling attempt.
metric: estimator coordinates divided by the prior widths (sgm_scale)

methods.single_window: the window's stored exact sample medoid (reused) or the exact medoid
methods.pooled: exact medoid up to 10000 rows; above it the collection kernel's Weiszfeld geometric median snapped to the nearest retained draw (weiszfeld_snap), an approximation to the exact medoid
methods.quantiles: mixture quantiles of the pooled draws in estimator coordinates (numpy linear interpolation); physical endpoints are the transform of the quantile
methods.representative_quantiles: inverse weighted empirical CDF (smallest value with cumulative weight >= p)

contract.coordinate_transform: parameterization.to_flow (log10 for log rows, linear rows as-is)
contract.input_conversion: read_cell_chunks(domain='stored'): 16-bit raw frames to 8-bit, normalize_video in the sampler
contract.input_conversion_status: verified: every source (60) records the same input conversion; the reference product does not record one

mu_r.source: adopted InlB detector estimator C128V42AP3LR32, record ..._INLB_2S_50FPS_C128V42AP3LR32_MAP_Experiment, median over the 600 per-window posterior medians (ten 2 s windows of the sixty recordings), transformed to physical units; MAP and SGM aggregates read beside it (MAP 2.256, SGM 2.253). Declared reference scenario: the estimator recovers mu_r on synthetic videos inside the prior box (MAE 0.009 dex, r 0.99) and returns, on the recordings, values beyond its training range (above the 2.0 px edge in 94 % of windows and in 57 of 60 recordings); retained under the source hierarchy because the recordings are read as wider than any in-box value and no in-box value is better supported (the lead, 2026-10-27). The localization per-detection width 1.47 against 1.36 for Fab (sec. 6.7 caveat 3) is the same direction and a different quantity
mu_r.limitation: an extrapolation of the learned flow beyond its tested imaging domain, which does not independently establish the physical PSF width of the InlB recordings; the in-domain value at the exact prior ceiling, 10^0.3 = 1.9952623 px, is the sensitivity scenario SEL_MU_R, and neither choice establishes the physical width; falls 0.02 dex along a recording; point estimate retained as produced, precision not established

sigma_r.source: adopted InlB detector estimator C128V42AP3LR32, same record and aggregation (MAP 0.4015, SGM 0.403); localization reference 0.42 as fitted (sec. 6.2). Neural estimate retained as a working value: synthetic recovery is demonstrated within the training domain (MAE 0.029 dex, r 0.98); experimental use here accompanies the extrapolated PSF-width estimate
sigma_r.limitation: the assembled vector lies outside the tested joint domain through mu_r; wider than Fab's 0.177; no within-recording trend (+0.01 dex, not significant); experimental accuracy model-dependent

mu_pc.source: adopted InlB detector estimator C128V42AP3LR32, same record and aggregation (MAP 156, SGM 148.1). Neural estimate retained as a working value: synthetic recovery is demonstrated within the training domain (MAE 0.024 dex, r 0.99); experimental use here accompanies the extrapolated PSF-width estimate. The localization per-detection brightness 690 against 386 for Fab is a spot-level sum (sec. 6.7 caveat 3); the per-dye ratio to Fab here is 1.46
mu_pc.limitation: window spread 0.29 dex and a fall of 0.20 dex along a recording (over 0.3 dex in 35 to 38 % of recordings), markedly less stable than Fab's; 18 to 20 % of windows below the 100-photon prior edge; a window median across a strong within-recording decline; a per-dye value under the labeling and camera assumptions

sigma_pc.source: adopted InlB detector estimator C128V42AP3LR32, same record and aggregation (MAP 0.8238, SGM 0.857); localization reference 0.55 as fitted (sec. 6.2). Neural estimate retained as a working value: synthetic recovery is demonstrated within the training domain (MAE 0.074 dex, r 0.92); experimental use here accompanies the extrapolated PSF-width estimate
sigma_pc.limitation: the same conditioning as mu_pc; 5 to 6 % of windows above the 1.0 prior edge; experimental accuracy model-dependent

prob_photo_bleach.source: declared: an explicit shared-rate assumption, the same dye, illumination, camera settings and 100-frame reference interval as MET-FAB, so the Fab empirically anchored value 0.05 is adopted as the practical baseline in the absence of an InlB decline analysis (the lead, 2026-10-27). The adopted estimator's own value (median 0.100, MAP 0.120) plays no part: it does not recover the parameter (r 0.02)
prob_photo_bleach.limitation: no measurement on the InlB recordings supports it; the swift track-termination rate for InlB (0.014 per frame against 0.010 for Fab, Rahm et al. 2021) does not establish a change in per-dye bleaching; the faster-loss value 0.10 is the declared sensitivity scenario SEL_PB10; an InlB decline analysis would supply an independent empirical constraint, not a direct measurement of this parameter, and is deferred

lambda_rate.source: declared, the rounded neural-based working choice from the adopted InlB detector estimator C128V42AP3LR32 (median 2.283 per second, MAP 2.664, SGM 2.376; window spread 0.36 dex); partially recovered (MAE 0.206 dex, r 0.53), so its digits are not retained; no InlB localization anchor exists
lambda_rate.limitation: unstable across windows and conditioned on the extrapolated PSF-width estimate; the unrounded neural medians differ by a factor of about 3.5 between the conditions (2.28 against 8.10) and the selected values by a factor of four (2 against 8), a difference the model attributes to the recordings and the record does not explain; Fab's value 8 is the shared-rate sensitivity scenario SEL_LAMBDA, a useful comparison that does not establish that both conditions must share one inferred effective flicker rate; rises 0.09 dex along a recording

selection.outside_prior_justification: mu_r 2.256 px lies above the detector prior box [1, 1.99526]: the adopted InlB estimator returns PSF-width estimates beyond its training range on 94 % of the experimental windows; this acknowledges an extrapolation beyond the tested imaging domain and certifies nothing about the physical PSF width (DETECTOR_WORKFLOW.md sec. 7.6 and 9.10; the lead, 2026-10-27)
selection.joint_uncertainty: none (a user-selected, fixed vector; no calibrated joint uncertainty)
